thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 03:17 UTC — Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Current error rate: 18% (baseline ~0.3%). Paging on-call.

oncall-ryan: ACK — I'm on it, paging in. Joining war room now. link: https://warroom.redwood.ai/r/incident/1867001111

sre-ana: I'm available to assist. Any immediate mitigation steps allowed? can we route to fallback model variant? :thinking_face:

oncall-ryan: Good q. Not yet — assessing root. telemetry shows spike starting ~03:12 UTC, mostly long-context requests (~8k tokens). Could be KV cache miss storm. Prioritize reducing load.

eng-maya: Noted. If it's KV-cache related we can enable aggressive prefix caching and short-circuit long-context paths. Need owner for model routing change.

oncall-ryan: I'll own model routing toggle. @ops-pat please stand by in case we need infra changes (traffic shift or scale-up).

ops-pat: Standing by. If we need more pods we can spin a burst pool, but will take ~4m to be warm.

product-kyle: Are customers impacted? any active customers reporting timeouts? support-jess, FYI.

support-jess: We have 3 incoming tickets from customers in EU complaining about 502/504s since ~03:14 UTC. Escalated. I'll keep inbound updates here.

oncall-ryan: Mitigation plan (initial):
1) Enable routing to smaller context model variant v2-small for non-critical traffic (canary 10%).
2) Enable aggressive KV prefix caching for v2-large to reduce misses.
3) If error rate persists >10% after 5m, initiate regional traffic shift to fallback region.

sre-ana: +1. I'll prepare the runtime change recipe. snippet for cfg to toggle:

```
# runtime routing override
route: /v1/generate
policy:
  primary_model: v2-large
  fallback: v2-small
  rollout: 0.1
```

oncall-ryan: Applying rollout 10% now — will monitor.

incident-bot: action-log: route.override created by oncall-ryan @ 03:18:12 UTC

eng-maya: Confirming KV cache settings push to v2-large (ttl=600 -> 3600) in progress.

incident-bot: metric-update: 03:20 UTC — error rate down to 9.8% (from 18%). Latency p95 on /v1/generate improved slightly.

product-kyle: Good. Draft status page message suggestion:

```
We are currently investigating increased error rates for the Redwood inference API's text generation endpoint (/v1/generate). Some customers may experience 5xx responses or timeouts. Engineers are actively mitigating (routing and cache tuning). We will provide updates every 15 minutes. Impacted regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1. Severity: partial outage.
```

oncall-ryan: I like that. support-jess can you post this on status.redwood.ai once we confirm stable <10% for next 5m? Otherwise mark 'investigating' now.

support-jess: Posting 'investigating' now. I'll include war room link and note that engineers are actively mitigting. Will attach incident number INC-1867001111.

incident-bot: statuspage.update: Investigating — posted by support-jess @ 03:21:05 UTC

ops-pat: FYI infra metrics show a spike in mem usage on several serving pods in eu-west-1 coincident with long-context requests. Might explain OOM-driven 502s.

sre-ana: If OOMs, temporary vertical increase may help, but prefer to shift load to v2-small and increase cache TTL to avoid OOM pressure.

oncall-ryan: Agree. Will keep rollout at 10% and start increasing to 30% if error rate stays >8% but latency OK.

incident-bot: paging: escalated to oncall-ryan, backup oncall-sam paged at 03:22 UTC

oncall-ryan: @oncall-sam if I need to hand off I'll ping. For now continuing.

eng-maya: Quick ask — do we need to notify enterprise customers with reserved capacity? product-kyle?

product-kyle: Yes, we'll notify any customers with SLA or active incidents open. I'll draft an email template:

```
Subject: Temporary service degradation impacting /v1/generate
Hi — Our team is investigating increased error rates affecting the generation API in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. We're reducing traffic to a fallback model to mitigate and tuning caches. No action required from you; we'll provide updates every 15 minutes. Sorry for the disruption.
```

support-jess: Sending to affected customers (IDs: C-432, C-210, C-106) now. I'll cc account teams.

incident-bot: metric-update: 03:27 UTC — error rate 6.2% after rollout increase to 30% for non-critical traffic. No new OOM logs in last 2m.

oncall-ryan: Good improvement. Increasing rollout to 50% for lower-latency traffic. Monitoring closely.

sre-ana: If we hit <5% and stable for 10m, plan to revert cache ttl back and start gradual cleanup of routing override. Does that sound ok?

oncall-ryan: Yes. We'll aim for revert plan after stability window. Summary for handoff (if needed):
- Incident ID: INC-1867001111
- Root cause (suspected): KV cache misses + long-context OOM pressure
- Mitigations applied: route override to v2-small (50% now), KV cache TTL increased
- Current status: Error rate 4.7% (03:32 UTC), status page updated to 'investigating' -> consider 'degraded performance' when stable

eng-maya: I'll create a quick runbook note in incident doc with commands and rollback steps.

support-jess: I'll update customers in 10m and add notes to support tickets.

oncall-ryan: Thanks all. If error rate remains <5% for 10m, I'll file a postmortem starter and hand back to normal ops. If anyone has to go offline, ping here before handing off.

ops-pat: Acknowledged. Standing by for any infra action.

incident-bot: note: handoff_ready_check @ 03:35 UTC

oncall-ryan: Final note before potential handoff — no need to page backup yet. continuing to monitor for 10 more minutes.

support-jess: I'll wait 10 and then update customers. Thx.

sre-ana: bookmarking war room link + logs. Will drop findings into the incident doc.

incident-bot: action-log: incident_acknowledged by oncall-ryan @ 03:18:30 UTC, mitigations_applied @ 03:20:40 UTC

oncall-ryan: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if conditions regress. Handback planned at 03:45 UTC if stable.
